pandas.read_clipboard.code:
import importlib
from inspect import signature

path = 'pandas.read_clipboard'
parts = path.split(".")
for end in range(len(parts), 0, -1):
    try:
        operation = importlib.import_module(".".join(parts[:end]))
        break
    except ImportError:
        continue

for name in parts[end:]:
    operation = getattr(operation, name)

print(path)
print(signature(operation))

import pandas as pd
from io import StringIO

csv = "id;units\n001;4\n002;MISSING\n"
orders = pd.read_csv(
    StringIO(csv),
    sep=";",
    dtype={"id": "string"},
    na_values=["MISSING"],
)
print(orders.to_string(index=False))

import importlib
from inspect import signature

    operation = getattr(operation, name)

import importlib
from inspect import signature

path = 'pandas.DataFrame.to_hdf'
parts = path.split(".")
for end in range(len(parts), 0, -1):
    try:
        operation = importlib.import_module(".".join(parts[:end]))
        break
    except ImportError:
        continue

for name in parts[end:]:
    operation = getattr(operation, name)

print(path)

Provide the pandas object, scalar, or array-like input described in the accepted values.
ဖော်ပြထားတဲ့ data type အတိုင်း pandas object၊ scalar ဒါမှမဟုတ် array ပုံစံကို ထည့်ပါ။
pandas.testing.assert_series_equal.returns: None when the checks pass. Raises AssertionError when they fail.
pandas.testing.assert_series_equal.code:
import pandas as pd
orders = pd.DataFrame({
    "team": ["North", "North", "South"],
    "day": pd.to_datetime(["2025-01-01", "2025-01-02", "2025-01-03"]),
    "units": [4, None, 7],
})
print(pd.testing.assert_series_equal(orders["units"], orders["units"].copy()))
pandas.testing.assert_series_equal.returnsMy: စစ်ဆေးချက်တွေ အောင်ရင် None ပြန်ပေးပါတယ်။ မအောင်ရင် AssertionError တက်ပါတယ်။
